newsitem.title: CANADA: Maple Leaf says hog plant layoffs seasonal.
newsitem.headline: Maple Leaf says hog plant layoffs seasonal.

text.p: Canada's largest food processor laid off the first 72 of 100 workers at its Winnipeg hog kill plant as part of a seasonal decline in production, a Maple Leaf Foods Inc spokeswoman told Reuters.
"The layoffs were in the processed meats department, not in the fresh kill section. These are seasonal layoffs," Maple Leaf spokeswoman Linda Smith said.
Maple Leaf Foods Inc hog packer Burns Meats issued 100 layoff notices last Thursday and 72 employees did not work Tuesday, United Food and Commercial Workers local 832 spokesman Don Keith said.
Burns employs about 800 workers at its Winnipeg plant.
The next largest packer, Schneider Corp, had not issued layoff notices, Keith said.
